name: Forward Sled Drag
steps: Attach a harness or hold the sled straps behind you, step forward until the straps pull taut, and lean forward from your ankles.
Brace your core with your torso angled cleanly forward in a straight acceleration line from head to rear heel.
Drive powerfully forward with alternating steps, pushing firmly through the ground and extending your trailing hip fully.
Maintain steady forward momentum for the target distance before slowing smoothly to a stop.
tips: Lean forward from your ankles with a flat back rather than bending forward at the waist.
Drive through powerful, rhythmic strides instead of short choppy steps so your glutes and hamstrings load fully.
